title: Seat movement and assorted complaints
summary: This topic combines a few clear complaints about seat positioning and repeated problems with several fragments that only mention movement or feature placement without enough context for a firm sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe annoyance with having to move the seat far forward for the theater screen and broader frustration about ongoing problems in the vehicle.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention moving to another vehicle, movable vents, seat or speaker placement, and general statements about something being moved without enough context to assign a clear sentiment.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes unrelated subjects such as seat position, speakers, vents, switching vehicles, and vague uses of the word 'moved'.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the topic has limited evidence for a single coherent customer issue.
Some fragments are too short or lack context to tell whether the customer is praising, criticizing, or simply describing a feature.
